name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta province of Argentina. The Diablillos deposit is one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally, with Measured and Indicated resources of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.54 million ounces of gold. The company completed a Pre-Feasibility Study showing a US$494M after-tax NPV and 26% IRR, and is progressing toward development under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI).
